title: The Magic Constellations
shortDescription: A connect-the-dots & coloring journey through the night sky.
fullDescription: A connect-the-dots & coloring journey through the night sky. Each page introduces a real constellation -- its shape, its story, and a fun fact about the stars that make it up -- before inviting kids to connect the dots and color the picture themselves. A gentle first step into astronomy that turns screen-free time into a night under the stars, no telescope required.
